main_title: The Flight of the Condor and the Eagle
main_sub: Awakening from the material to the divine
header_desc: The encounter of the Condor and the Eagle transfers mystical concepts such as <q>the rapture</q>, <q>the resurrection</q>, or the <q>new heaven and earth</q> from the dogmatic to the scientific and spiritual plane. It reveals that the Primordial Consciousness is a cosmic condition unrelated to religion whose mission is to show us how to free ourselves from the physical plane to return to the spiritual, showing us that thought belongs to the material psyche and feeling to the divine pneuma.
left_title: The Return of Sophia: From the Prison of Yaldabaoth 🧠 to the Kingdom of the ONE ❤️
left_body: The Gnostic gospels, written almost two thousand years ago, hold the key to one of the greatest enigmas of modern physics: quantum gravity. The EGO possesses mass and creates the tempo-material illusion of the psyche 🧠; to counteract it, the cosmos offers us a Universal, timeless and spaceless Consciousness —the ONE—, that allows you to return to the divine timelessness of the pneuma ❤️.
universe_light_text: Understanding that death is not an absolute end, but a transformation, frees us from ignorance. In the right hemisphere —our pneuma— resides the timeless and divine plane, the high-frequency spiritual plane | 999⟩ is the origin of the cosmos where the Invisible Father dwells. There is the land of union and freedom (The Great Homeland).
center_text: The Kingdom of God is within you (Gospel of Thomas, logion 3): Human consciousness manifests through two fundamental states: the spiritual |ONE⟩ —represented by Pistis Sophia and associated with the right hemisphere ❤️—, and the material |EGO⟩ —represented by the Demiurge Yaldabaoth and associated with the left hemisphere 🧠—. This shows us that we have free will of perception, which can be mathematically formalized as an inner product ⟨ONE|EGO⟩.
universe_mat_text: The human body is composed of carbon-12 (6p^+, 6e^-, 6n^0). In the left hemisphere resides the temporal and material plane, the low-frequency physical plane | 666⟩ the end of the cosmos where Yaldabaoth dwells. There is a place where: <q>war is peace, freedom is slavery, and ignorance is strength</q> (1984).
final_quote: When the Northern Eagle and the Southern Condor fly together in the same sky, Mother Earth will awaken and humanity will heal.
p2_sub: Condor and Eagle: The Flight of Science and Spirituality
cap1_title: Chapter 1: The Prophecy of the Condor and the Eagle { footnotesize color{golddark}(00:10 -- 01:07)}
cap1_desc: Premise and framework of integration: the reconciliation between the intuitive wisdom of the South (the heart, ancestral knowledge, and the spirit) and the technological development of the North (reason, science, and the mind). The call for balance to initiate evolutionary awakening and transcend the state of duality.
cap2_title: Chapter 2: Quantum Gravity and Temporal Illusion { footnotesize color{golddark}(01:13 -- 02:42)}
cap2_desc: The fundamental clash in theoretical physics: General Relativity versus Quantum Mechanics. Why Newton's and Maxwell's laws do not distinguish between past and future, Einstein's rupture of simultaneity, and the dissolution of linear time as a neural reconstruction of memory.
cap3_title: Chapter 3: Consciousness and Space-Time { footnotesize color{golddark}(02:47 -- 05:19)}
cap3_desc: The Faggin--Segarra conceptual ensemble: the body as a vehicle operated by a conscious quantum field outside space-time, where qualia reside. Consciousness does not arise from the brain but precedes it, converging with the First Consciousness and the Intelligent Designer free of time and space.
cap4_title: Chapter 4: Gnosis and Material Illusion { footnotesize color{golddark}(05:27 -- 08:39)}
cap4_desc: The Nag Hammadi discovery (1945) and the Coptic codices: the material cosmos conceived not as a home but as an enclosure for the soul. The teaching of the Gospel of Thomas (Logion 3): Jesus did not come to establish a religion of dogmas but to liberate the inner spark from the prison of the Demiurge through remembrance (gnosis).
cap5_title: Chapter 5: The Kingdom of Light and the Prison of the Demiurge { footnotesize color{golddark}(08:43 -- 10:16)}
cap5_desc: The Demiurge Yaldabaoth —also known as the great architect of matter— is the creator of the sensible world, a self-centered god ignorant of true divinity. On the other hand, Sophia lies captive in the density of matter, awaiting the spark of awakening.
cap6_title: Chapter 6: The Dajjal and the Universal Hemispheres { footnotesize color{golddark}(10:23 -- 14:38)}
cap6_desc: The compared eschatology and perceptual distortion: the figure of the Dajjal and the visual trick of the inverted paradise (the river and the fire). The mechanism of Orwellian doublethink (1984) as the cognitive prison of the ego, versus the revolutionary message of Jesus that dismantles the imperial slavery system.
cap7_title: Chapter 7: Reflections on Our Place in the Cosmos { footnotesize color{golddark}(14:40 -- 16:30)}
cap7_desc: In the end, the great paradox boils down to this: in the immensity of the cosmos —with its more than two trillion galaxies— is where the phrase of Jesus resonates most strongly: «The Father and I are one». Could this have an hidden message about the deep connection between humanity and the cosmos?
sagan_quote: <q>The idea that God is a white man, larger than usual, with a flaming beard, sitting in the sky and counting the fall of every sparrow, is ridiculous. But if by God one means the set of physical laws that govern the universe, then clearly such a God exists. However, this God is emotionally unsatisfying... there is little point in praying to the law of gravity</q>
